# P36.57 — explore bar and scoped search placement (row 400, K6 VIZ-03)

**Base:** `r11/P36.56-scoped-search-forms` · **Head:** `r11/P36.57-explore-bar-and-scoped-search`
**Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · **live_verification=false** · **Gate status:** none
**Production mutations (OM-14):** none — `web/` sources, styles, registries and tests only.

## What lands

1. **The three explore links carry `sig.workspace-state/2`** (`lib/explore-links.ts` + `DossierExploreBar.astro`): `Explore on the map` → `/map/?v=2&view=map&jurisdiction=<jkey>`, `See connections` → `/network/?v=2&view=graph&jurisdiction=<jkey>` (the facet now rides the graph link — a received-but-unapplied facet is visibly named on arrival, never silently dropped), `Search within <place>` → `/search/?v=2&view=list&jurisdiction=<jkey>`. All minted through the P36.21 registry serialiser — canonical order, byte-stable round-trips (unit-pinned).
2. **The scoped GET form + `scope=` typeahead** — composed from P36.56 unchanged; the e2e asserts the dossier's `jurisdiction=<jkey>` scope beside the bar.
3. **The unapplied-facet notice (NEW-1/UXR-10, SIG-UI-060)** — the fallback note while targets ignore facets: e2e pins the notice naming "a jurisdiction filter" on all three explore targets and "a jurisdiction filter and a source filter" on the per-row map links; a surface honouring a received parameter (`q` on `/search/`) shows none.
4. **K5 §5.5 "Show on the map"** on every contributing source row of the dossier sources explorer (`DossierSourcesExplorer.astro`): the scoped `/map/?v=2&…&jurisdiction=…&source=…` link + the no-JS records list on the release-pinned federated route (`type=record&jurisdiction=…&source=…&format=html`, K3 SRCH-04). The in-place Figure-1 activation half stays VIZ-04's; the links are the complete variant today.

## Honest variants (SIG-ENG-042)

- Unkeyed dossier → the links emit without `jurisdiction=` and the search link reads `Search the release →` (never a guessed key).
- Source row with `located_by_point = 0` → `no located records` instead of a "Show on the map" link to an empty view (unit-covered; every fixture row has located records).
- No activated release → `no activated release` instead of a records-list dead link.
- Entity→graph-view link stays a named absence: `/network/` `focus=` resolves node ids, not entity keys, so a link would always miss — the typed absence is honest; it rides SIG-UI-055's PARTIAL verdict → P37.64 ACC-EXPLORE.
